name: Duthorian Rall
summary: Duthorian Rall is a respected human knight of the Silver Hand stationed within Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. Renowned as one of the most influential paladins in the Alliance, he oversees the training and spiritual trials of emerging holy warriors. He guides recruits through solemn vows of charity, valor, and devotion to defend Azeroth against the Scourge and lurking domestic threats.

sections.title: A Pillar of the Silver Hand
sections.body: Standing within the vaulted transept of the Cathedral of Light, Duthorian Rall represents the venerable traditions of the Knights of the Silver Hand. With the kingdom unsettled by internal strife and the missing King Varian Wrynn, Duthorian shoulders the vital duty of instilling righteous discipline in fresh initiates. Respected paladins in the field, including Brother Wilhelm in Northshire and Brandur Ironhammer in Ironforge, direct promising recruits to his guidance to begin their sacred trials.

sections.title: Trials of Compassion and Life
sections.body: Duthorian teaches that martial power without moral foundation is hollow. Through the Tome of Divinity, he tests a paladin's capacity for empathy, requiring acts of mercy and selfless service across Stormwind before entrusting them with deeper mysteries. His trials culminate in testing candidates with the Symbol of Life near Heroes' Vigil, sending them to aid wounded allies and teach them to channel the Light's miraculous power to restore fallen comrades from death.

sections.title: The Price of Valor
sections.body: Beyond spiritual contemplation, Duthorian demands resolute courage in the face of peril. In his tests of valor, he cautions aspirants that their vows may demand their lives. He tests this resolve by sending initiates into dangerous territory—such as defending Daphne Stilwell against Defias renegades in Westfall—before directing them on toward master smith Jordan Stilwell outside Ironforge and granting them holy steeds worthy of their station.

faq.answer: Duthorian Rall is a prominent knight of the Silver Hand residing in the Cathedral of Light within Stormwind City. He serves as an instructor and spiritual mentor for new paladins, testing their devotion and courage on behalf of the Church of the Holy Light.

faq.q: Where can Duthorian Rall be found?
faq.answer: He can be found standing in the eastern wing of the Cathedral of Light, located at the heart of the Cathedral Square in Stormwind City.

faq.q: What is his connection to the Tome of Divinity?
faq.answer: Duthorian provides paladins with the Book of Divinity and guides them through trials of humility, compassion, and rescue. Fulfilling his trials proves an initiate is worthy to wield the Light's power of resurrection.

faq.q: Why does Duthorian send paladins to Westfall?
faq.answer: During the trial for the Tome of Valor, Duthorian sends paladins to protect Daphne Stilwell from Defias bandits on her farm in Westfall, demonstrating their willingness to sacrifice themselves to defend the innocent.

faq.q: What rewards does Duthorian grant to paladins who pass his trials?
aliases: what do you get from duthorian
faq.answer: Successful paladins earn key holy capabilities through his guidance, including the sacred gift of resurrection, the ability to sense undead, protective armaments such as the Bastion of Stormwind, and eventually their summoned warhorse.

faq.q: Who sends adventurers to Duthorian initially?
faq.answer: Aspirants are typically directed to him by paladin trainers, including Brother Wilhelm in Northshire Valley and Brandur Ironhammer in Ironforge.

angles.text: Duthorian Rall is one of your primary spiritual mentors in Stormwind, testing your compassion and valor through foundational trials that unlock the power of resurrection, divine senses, and your warhorse.
As an influential leader within the Silver Hand, Duthorian ensures that the Alliance's defenders remain morally upright and capable of defending the realm against bandits and undead alike.
Anchored in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, Duthorian represents the enduring devotion and chivalric discipline central to human faith and society.
